chapters.title: Birth of a Luminary
chapters.goal: Climb Cobblestone Tor with Gemma, win your first fights and reach the summit to finish the coming-of-age ceremony.

steps.t: Choose your weapon: the [[Cobblestone Greatsword]] for more damage or the [[Cobblestone Sword]] if you want a shield.
Talk to Dunstan, the Elder, at the bridge.
Beat the [[Slime]] group up the path with plain attacks; Sandy helps and cannot fall.
Search behind the monument on the left for a [[Pot Lid]].
Equip the [[Pot Lid]] only if you kept the sword.
Turn right at the first cave fork.
Climb the wall.
Take the [[Medicinal Herb]] by the tree.
Start every fight by swinging at the monster on the field so it takes damage before the battle.
Turn right at the fork past the bridge.
Smash the pots by the stairs for a [[Medicinal Herb]] and 5G.
Pick up the [[Copper Ore]] from the sparkly spot deeper in the caverns.
Fight the pair of [[Smog]]s.
Keep HP above 10.
Let Gemma heal you.
Use [[Frizz]] if your hits keep missing.
Grab the [[Pink Pine]] by the tree in the northwest corner.
Climb the rope.
After the Gryphon scene at the summit, take the second [[Pink Pine]] by the northwest tree.
Enter the cave.

get: [[Pot Lid]] - chest behind the monument at the base

chapters.title: Cobblestone
chapters.goal: Loot your home village, finish its first quest and leave for Heliodor with a map and a horse.

steps.t: Go to your house in the northeast.
Talk to Amber to receive the [[Precious Pendant]].
Leave the house at night.
Meet Gemma by the large tree near the entrance.
Search your home: the cupboard has [[Plain Clothes]] and the upstairs pots hold 10G.
Climb the crates onto the shed roof next door for a 50G chest and a [[Flurry Feather]].
Talk to the quest villager below your house to start [[The People's Friend]].
Hand over the [[Flurry Feather]] for a [[Sleeping Hibiscus]].
Check every bookshelf you pass from now on; red books can be recipe books.
Buy a [[Bandana]] and [[Wayfarer's Clothes]] at the Item Shop.
Skip the [[Cypress Stick]].
Smash the barrels in the southeast cave for a [[Seed of Agility]], a [[Copper Ore]] and 7G.
Open the chest behind Gemma's house for a [[Cypress Stick]].
Climb Gemma's roof for a [[Medicinal Herb]].
Take the [[Fresh Water]] at the top of the waterfall by your house.
Go to the north entrance.
Talk to Dunstan for the Map of Erdrea, a horse and Gemma's Charm.

get: [[Seed of Agility]] - barrel in the southeast cave
50G and [[Flurry Feather]] - shed roof next to your house

chapters.title: Heliodor Region
chapters.goal: Walk north from Cobblestone through the Heliodor Region to the city of Heliodor, looting both paths and the first camp.

level.t: Reach level 5 on the way to the camp; it teaches [[Heal]] and unlocks the Character Builder.

steps.t: Equip Gemma's Charm, which you just received.
Travel on foot instead of by horse, so a strike on a field monster opens the battle with damage already dealt.
Search the ruins on the left before the first clearing for a [[Chimaera Wing]].
Kill [[Stark Raven]]s first in each fight, since they speed themselves up.
Keep right on the north path to open a chest with a [[Seed of Life]].
Spend your first skill points on [[Greatsword Guard]] for greatswords or [[Flame Slash]] for swords.
Save at the camp statue.
Loot the cabin pots, the 80G chest behind it and the well's [[Strong Medicine]].
Go east from camp.
Mine the crystal on the south wall for 2 [[Copper Ore]] and a [[Flintstone]].
Level up on [[Bunicorn]]s and [[Stark Raven]]s along the Road to the Emerald Coast; the tent at its end has a [[Chimaera Wing]].
Keep HP above 15 on the eastern path, where [[Hammerhood]]s and [[Fright Bulb]]s appear.
Open the chest behind the wall where the [[Platypunk]] slumps for a [[Single Phial]].
Take the southwest path for the [[Toad Oil]] barrel on the pier and the [[Fresh Water]] spot.
Rest at camp.
Cross the north bridge.
Harvest the northwest flower point.
Enter Heliodor.

get: [[Seed of Life]] - chest on the north path, keep right
[[Single Phial]] - chest behind the wall on the eastern path

chapters.title: Heliodor
chapters.goal: Loot Heliodor and its castle and finish both town quests before meeting the King, since that audience locks you out of town.

steps.t: Talk to the man by the castle stairs north of the fountain to start [[The Soldier and the Strategist - A Tale of Two Heroes]].
Buy a new sword or greatsword at the Weapon shop, plus a [[Leather Hat]] and [[Leather Armour]] ([[Leather Shield]] for sword users).
Climb the ladder south of the shops.
Drop down the large house's chimney.
Open the balcony chest for a [[Gold Bracer]].
Talk to the girl outside the Inn to start [[Amelia's in a Pickle!]].
Climb the Item shop ladder to the roof.
Pick up the cat.
Jump the crate to the east roof for a mini medal.
Return the cat to the girl to receive [[Kitty Litter]].
Search the bookshelf in the far southeast house for the quest book.
Give the book to the man by the castle stairs for a [[Drasilian Shilling]].
Open the chest under the stairs of the northeast Royal Square house for 100G.
Go through the bush in the southeast house's garden to the hidden chest with a [[Seed of Sorcery]].
Enter the castle by day.
Loot the castle first; the top-floor balcony barrel holds a mini medal.
Go to the throne room to meet the King; this moves the story on.

get: Mini medal - roof chest east of the Item shop
Mini medal - castle top-floor balcony barrel
[[Gold Bracer]] - balcony chest of the large house west of the fountain
[[Seed of Deftness]] - pot in the same house, entered by the chimney
[[Seed of Strength]] - barrel behind the guard east of town
[[Seed of Therapeusis]] - castle top floor, east corridor pot

chapters.title: Heliodor Sewers
chapters.goal: Break out of the dungeon with your cellmate, slip through the sewers and flee the Black Dragon.

steps.t: Smash the pots in your cell.
Walk to the cell door to meet the other prisoner.
Go back into the cell.
Talk to your partner to find the hidden passage.
Turn right at the first junction for a [[Medicinal Herb]] by the locked door.
Take the other path.
Run from the soldiers at the bridge.
If the soldiers catch you, heal during the fight before HP gets low.
Run to the crates to sneak past the guards.
Wait for the next guard to turn his back.
Wait for the final guard to walk north.
Save at the Goddess Statue in the caves below.
Flee the [[Black Dragon]] without fighting by dashing toward the screen until you jump into the water.

chapters.title: Return to Heliodor
chapters.goal: Recruit Erik, explore the Heliodorian Foothills, then use Downtown Heliodor to trace the Red Orb to The Kingsbarrow.

steps.t: Smash the pots by your bed.
Talk to the Priest.
Talk to [[Erik]] outside to recruit him.
Set Erik to manual control.
Build Erik's Knives toward [[Sleeper Hit]] and Pursecutter, plus [[Half-Inch]].
Talk to the warrior by the church to start [[It Takes Two to Tango]].
Finish a monster with The Real Decoy when both are pepped.
Climb down the church well for a [[Pointy Hat]] (equip it), a [[Small Scale]] and a [[Hardy Hide]].
Kill [[Stump Chump]]s first since they heal allies.
Keep HP up against [[Great Sabrecub]]s.
Open the hidden chest between a tree and rocks in the southeast of the open area for a [[Red Eye]].
Follow the south path past the bridge to the chest with a [[Seed of Strength]].
Keep HP topped up across the bridge, where [[Great Sabrecat]]s have high HP and hard hits.
Turn in the quest at the church for a [[Gold Chain]].
Equip the [[Gold Chain]].
Harvest [[Buzzberries]] at the tree point on the hill path before entering Downtown Heliodor.
Buy Erik the better dagger and [[Leather Armour]] in Downtown Heliodor.
Give a [[Holy Water]] and a [[Buzzberries]] to the girl with the dog.
Let the dog scare off the guard instead of paying 2000G.
Cross the roofs to Derk's Shop in the Royal Square.
Smash the upstairs pots for a mini medal.
Leave through Downtown.
Head southwest to The Manglegrove.

get: Mini medal - upstairs pots in Derk's Shop
[[Pointy Hat]] - chest in the well outside the church
[[Gold Chain]] - reward for It Takes Two to Tango
[[Drasilian Guinea]] - upper-layer drop-down chest in Downtown Heliodor; sells for 500G

chapters.title: The Manglegrove
chapters.goal: Cross The Manglegrove, unlock the Fun-Size Forge, beat the Tricky Devil so the bridge is fixed, and reach Cobblestone.

steps.t: Talk to the merchant south of the entrance; he sells [[Flintstone]], [[Small Scale]] and [[Fresh Water]] for forging.
Target [[Dancing Devil]]s and [[Sham Hatwitch]]es early, and carry [[Antidotal Herb]]s for [[Bubble Slime]] poison.
Talk to every cow you find; they forecast weather and 10 of them unlock a trophy.
Take the east path.
Climb the ledges to the flower point.
Open the ledge chest for a mini medal.
Cross the south bridge to the camp, where Erik hands over the [[Fun-Size Forge]] and a recipe book.
Forge the [[Divine Dagger]] for Erik from a [[Copper Ore]] and [[Fresh Water]] if the Luminary uses greatswords.
Spend the pearls you earn reworking the Luminary's greatsword.
Open the chest in the camp hut for [[Economies of Scale]].
Forge [[Scale Armour]] (and a [[Scale Shield]] for sword users).
Touch the root east of camp.
Take the west path from the central clearing to the hidden chest.
Fight the [[Tricky Devil]] (145 HP) with regular attacks.
Keep everyone above 20 HP because of its [[Sizz]].
Cross the repaired bridge.
Climb the rope at the far end.
Open the chest north of the ore point for a [[Single Phial]].
Exit east.
Detour into the cave east of the Cobblestone entrance for 5 pearls.
Go south to Cobblestone.

get: [[Fun-Size Forge]] - from Erik at the camp
[[Economies of Scale]] - chest in the camp hut
Mini medal - ledge chest on the east path

chapters.title: Cobblestone and The Emerald Coast
chapters.goal: Witness Cobblestone's past and ruined present, dig up the Keystone at Cobblestone Falls, and prepare at the Emerald Coast camp.

steps.t: Go to your house.
Talk to Amber.
Follow young Gemma to the pier.
Talk to the boy and old man.
Return up to the village to end the vision of the past.
Open the chest in the ruined church for [[O Holy Knight]].
Leave by the north exit.
Take the east path to The Emerald Coast.
Examine the three-sided rock at Cobblestone Falls to dig up the box with the letters and the Keystone.
Open the chest on the cliff west of the weather cow for a [[Hardy Hide]].
Rest at the camp.
Forge a [[Templar's Uniform]] for Erik from [[Buzzberries]] and [[Cottontop]], reworking it toward +3.
Skip the new greatsword in the camp shop if you already have a [[Copper Chopper]] +3.
Harvest the tree point northeast of camp and the flower point toward the beach.
Rest at camp again.
Leave the area to the south for The Kingsbarrow.

get: [[O Holy Knight]] - chest in the ruined Cobblestone church

chapters.title: The Kingsbarrow
chapters.goal: Take back the Red Orb from The Kingsbarrow by beating the Grim Gryphons, then escape through the Door of Departure.

steps.t: Smash the pot in the tent at the start for a [[Single Phial]].
Go downstairs.
Turn right at the first junction.
Climb outside for the [[Hardy Hide]] spot by the rubble.
Climb out at the next junction.
Go south to the chest with a [[Strength Ring]].
Give the [[Strength Ring]] to the Luminary.
Defeat the [[Mecha-mynah]]s in the north room.
Take the [[Wing of Bat]] spot.
Open the chest behind the [[Smog]] group to the west for a [[Templar's Uniform]].
Defeat a sparkling [[Eggsoskeleton]].
Mount the [[Eggsoskeleton]].
Jump to the chests with a [[Seed of Defence]] and [[Put a Feather in Your Cap]].
Drop to the door for 2 [[Magic Water]].
Heal everyone to full HP and MP.
Fight the [[Grim Gryphon]]s (about 130HP each).
Sleep them with [[Sleeper Hit]].
Hit them with [[Sizz]].
Use [[Scorched Earth]] instead if both of you are pepped.
Use [[Evac]] to leave.
Rest at the Emerald Coast camp.
Try the forge's first flourish (a forge technique that strikes two gauges at once); it unlocks if you are at least level 10.
Forge a [[Feathered Cap]] each for the Luminary and Erik from a [[Hardy Hide]] and a [[Flurry Feather]].
Walk east under the tree to the Door of Departure.

get: [[Put a Feather in Your Cap]] - Basement 3F chest, reached on an Eggsoskeleton mount
[[Strength Ring]] - chest outside the temple's upper level
[[Seed of Defence]] - Basement 3F chest

chapters.title: Hotto and the Hotto Steppe
chapters.goal: Explore Hotto, meet Veronica, finish Hotto's two forging quests, and level up before The Cryptic Crypt.

level.t: Be at least level 10 on the Steppe and reach level 12 on [[Robber Rabbit]]s before The Cryptic Crypt.

steps.t: Save with the Priest by the Door.
Kill [[Bongo Drongo]]s first since they call help as well as raising enemy attack.
Grab the [[Warmaline]] and [[Lava Lump]] spots south of town.
Enter Hotto.
Open the chest behind the west house for a mini medal and the chest behind the Inn for [[An Introduction to Armour]].
Talk to the blacksmith west of the second Item shop to start [[Smiths and Sparkly Spots]].
Talk to the man behind the bar to start [[Put a Ring on It]] and receive [[Twenty-Four Carats of Class]] and 2 [[Gold Ore]].
Buy Erik a [[Poison Moth Knife]], but hold off on the iron weapons and [[Chain Mail]].
Pay the woman at the end of the bath walkway 20G for a puff-puff; it counts toward a trophy.
Bring Connie to the girl at the entrance so [[Veronica]] joins you.
Go to the bar.
Mine [[Iron Ore]] west across the bridge.
Forge [[Bronze Armour]] and the [[Gold Ring]] +1 at the camp.
Fly back to Hotto.
Turn in both quests for [[I ♥ Iron Arms]] and a [[Crucerang]].
Forge a [[Cast-Iron Claymore]] for the Luminary from [[Iron Ore]] and [[Copper Ore]], aiming for +3.
Go south from camp.
Hug the cliff east of the [[Glass Frit]] spot.
Open the chest for a mini medal.
Go northwest from camp past the ore point.
Enter The Cryptic Crypt.

get: Mini medal - chest behind the west house in Hotto
Mini medal - chest in the far southwest of the Steppe
[[An Introduction to Armour]] - chest behind the Hotto Inn
[[Twenty-Four Carats of Class]] - from the Put a Ring on It quest giver
[[I ♥ Iron Arms]] - reward for Smiths and Sparkly Spots
[[Crucerang]] - reward for Put a Ring on It

chapters.title: The Cryptic Crypt
chapters.goal: Find Serena, beat Jarvis to restore Veronica's magic, and leave Hotto with the twins and the Zoom spell.

steps.t: Make [[Mud Mannequin]]s and [[Skullrider]]s your first targets in every fight.
Walk toward the chest at the second junction to fall through.
Open the chest behind you for a [[Yggdrasil Leaf]].
Take the west path near the root to drop again for a [[Feathered Cap]] and 2 [[Gold Ore]].
Defeat the sparkling [[Skullrider]].
Ride the [[Skullrider]] up the walls marked with footprints.
Climb back up.
Collect the chests on that floor: 1000G, [[Robber Gloves]], a mini medal and a [[Silver Platter]].
Save at the Goddess Statue by the fountain.
Give Erik some [[Medicinal Herb]]s.
Touch the root to learn the password.
Say it at the door.
Fight [[Jarvis]] (around 260 HP) and his Shadows (around 70 HP).
Open with [[Cutting Edge]].
Follow with Erik's [[Sleeper Hit]] into Pursecutter.
Heal the party right after Jarvis uses Cool Breath.
Do not bother stealing.
Take the [[Iron Ore]] spot and the [[Grubby Bandage]] pot in the boss room.
Build [[Veronica]] in Heavy Wands and Vim, and [[Serena]] in Wands and Harpistry.
Give Serena the [[Silver Platter]] if the Luminary uses greatswords.
Leave Hotto to learn [[Zoom]].
Sell your [[Chimaera Wing]]s.
Go southwest to the checkpoint.
Show your pass at the checkpoint to enter the Gallopolis Region.

get: Mini medal - Basement 1F chest
[[Robber Gloves]] - Basement 1F chest
[[Yggdrasil Leaf]] - chest in the pit
1000G - Basement 1F chest

chapters.title: The Sultanate of Gallopolis
chapters.goal: Win the Sand National for Prince Faris, beat the Slayer of the Sands, and recruit Sylvando before heading to Gondolia.

level.t: Be around level 15 for the Slayer of the Sands.

steps.t: Open the chest on the western edge south of Gallopolis for a mini medal.
Register the southwest camp.
In town, open the southwest-corner chest for a mini medal.
Take [[So You Want to Be a Witch]] from the Inn bookshelf.
Accept [[A Walk on the Wild Side]] from the painter in the northwest and [[A Cactus Cutlet to Die For]] in the Tavern.
Buy [[Bunny Ears]] for the girls, but skip the shop wands since you can forge better.
Loot the palace, including 1500G behind the throne.
Meet Faris at the circus at night.
Win the Sand National by grabbing every green swirl and letting go of dash when stamina runs low.
Fight [[Cactiball]]s near the South Campsite until a [[Golden Globe]] joins a battle.
Turn in the globule.
Forge the [[Wizard's Staff]] for Veronica first.
Forge the [[Tricky Turban]] and [[Enchantress's Gloves]] next.
At night in the Celestial Sands, with the Luminary, Erik and Serena pepped, finish a [[Spitzfire]] with [[Wild Side]].
Fight the [[Slayer of the Sands]] (around 710 HP).
Cast [[Sap]] and [[Decelerate]] on it.
Keep [[Buff]] on Veronica.
Answer [[Kasap]] with Buff.
Hit it with [[Zap]] or [[Cutting Edge]], Veronica's [[Frizz]], and Erik's [[Sleeper Hit]] into Pursecutter.
Switch the Luminary to healing if Serena is confused.
Win the Bronze and Silver Cups at the track, cutting right at turn 3 on the Silver course.
Put [[Sylvando]] on the path to [[Hustle Dance]] right away.
Accept [[A Lovely Letter]] at the western checkpoint.
Show the Sultan's letter to enter Gondolia.

get: Mini medal - chest south of Gallopolis
Mini medal - southwest-corner chest in town
[[So You Want to Be a Witch]] - Inn bookshelf
[[Traveller's Hood]] - church wardrobe
[[Gold Bracer]] - Bronze Cup on the difficult setting
[[Gallopolitan Garb]] - Silver Cup on easy

chapters.title: Gondolia
chapters.goal: Cross Laguna di Gondolia, fetch the cure from Grotta della Fonte for the Doge's son, and beat Jasper to rescue Erik and gain a ship.

level.t: Be at least level 18 for Grotta della Fonte.

steps.t: Defeat a sparkling [[Midnight Horknight]].
Fly the [[Midnight Horknight]] to the small islands, including the [[Seed of Skill]] chest for Sylvando.
Kill [[Muddy Hand]]s first because they keep calling for help.
Open the central-platform chest for a mini medal and the northern island chest for [[I ♥ Iron Armour]].
Take [[A Slender Sword of Solid Silver]] from the western swamp's central platform.
Forge Sylvando a [[Silver Rapier]] at the camp after reporting your targets.
Take [[Filigree for Fun and Profit]] from the Gondolia church bookshelf.
Haggle between the two Cat Suit brothers until it drops to 1,000G if you want Veronica's cat look.
Swap letters with the woman near the Doge's house and the Gallopolis guard for [[Cutting-Edge Kit]].
Accept [[An Even Lovelier Letter]].
Search the upstairs wardrobe in the house north of her for a mini medal.
At the Grotta della Fonte camp, forge [[Gold Platter]]s, a [[Fur Hood]], an [[Iron Mask]] and [[Iron Cuirass]]es.
Fight the two [[Coralossus]] (around 230 HP each) with the Luminary's [[Zap]], [[Sap]], and [[Oomph]] on the Luminary and Erik.
Climb the rope past the lake for the [[Seed of Magic]] and [[Green Eye]] chests.
Zoom to Gondolia.
Beat the [[Heliodorian guard]]s with [[Zap]] and [[Bang]].
Cross the Inn roofs.
Take the gondola to the stage.
Fight [[Jasper]] (around 630 HP).
Use magic during Sword Stance.
Keep [[Buff]] on Veronica.
Cast [[Sap]] and [[Decelerate]] on him.
Cure Fizzle fast.

get: Mini medal - central swamp, central platform chest
Mini medal - wardrobe in the house north of the Doge's
Mini medal - Grotta della Fonte, chest south of the camp
[[I ♥ Iron Armour]] - central swamp, northern island chest
[[A Slender Sword of Solid Silver]] - western swamp, central platform chest
[[Filigree for Fun and Profit]] - Gondolia church bookshelf

chapters.title: Search for the Rainbough
chapters.goal: Sail to Zwaardsrust and Octagonia, win the martial arts tournament with Vince, and beat Arachtagon under the orphanage.

level.t: Be around levels 18-20 in Zwaardsrust and at least level 22 before Arachtagon.

steps.t: Stop at Insula Australis.
Open the chest on the southern islet for [[Rings Around the World]].
Kill [[Tap Devil]]s first in Zwaardsrust; they make the whole party dance and curse it.
Search the hay field west of the Warrior's Rest Inn slowly at night for a non-sparkling mini medal.
Take [[Smithing with Steel]] from the Inn's upstairs bookshelf and the balcony chest's mini medal.
Accept [[A Path to Paradise]].
Use [[Care Prayer]] on a [[Deadnaut]] in the western ruins at night.
Ride a [[Horknight]] over the lake in north Dundrasil to the chest with a [[Necklace of Immunity]].
In Octagonia, buy [[Tough Guy Tattoo]]s for the Luminary and Erik and the [[Rod of Rapidity]] for Veronica.
Take the mini medal pot in the alcove at the bottom of town and [[Building Butterfly Bric-a-Brac]] in the Orphanage.
In the tournament, use [[Cutting Edge]].
Focus [[Underdigger]] first and [[Sinderella]] second.
Defend when both foes are pepped.
Focus [[Sterling Sylva]].
Cure poison at once.
Hit [[Rab]] first in the final.
Heal below 80 HP.
Trigger fights at the metal orbs in the Caverns under Octagonia for [[Metal Slime]]s.
Take the [[Assassin's Dagger]] for Erik.
Beat the [[Cannibox]] in the right chest of the northwest pair for a [[Seed of Skill]].
Fight [[Arachtagon]] (around 1270 HP).
Heal with [[Hustle Dance]].
Keep [[Acceleratle]] up.
Cast [[Buff]] and [[Sap]].
Cast [[Oomph]] on Veronica for fire spells.
Accept [[Skincare for the Fierce and Fabulous]].
Finish [[The Shadow]] for a mini medal.

get: Mini medal - hidden in the hay field west of Warrior's Rest Inn
Mini medal - Warrior's Rest Inn balcony chest
Mini medal - Octagonia, pot in the alcove under the stairs
Mini medal - Caverns under Octagonia, east chest
[[Smithing with Steel]] - Warrior's Rest Inn bookshelf
[[Rings Around the World]] - Insula Australis, southern chest

chapters.title: To Dundrasil Castle Ruins
chapters.goal: Cross the Dundrasil Region to the castle ruins, follow Rab to the truth about your birth, and gain Rab, Jade and the Rainbough.

steps.t: Build the Luminary toward [[Cutting Edge]], [[Frost Fangs]] and [[Zap]], Erik toward dual wielding, and Sylvando to [[Hustle Dance]].
Pick the gold flower point in the northwest for the [[Mellow Vera]].
Shoot the target in the tree beside the flower point.
Ride a [[Horknight]] to the west island for a [[Drasilian Sovereign]].
Climb the ruins northeast of the camp to the ladder and chest with a [[Bandit Blade]].
Zoom to Octagonia to turn in [[Skincare for the Fierce and Fabulous]] for a recipe book.
Forge a [[Batterfly Knife]] if Erik dual wields, plus the [[Dapper Doublet]] and [[Natty Cravat]] for Sylvando.
Climb the northern of the two small ruins to the balcony chest with a [[Seed of Life]].
Open the chest on the north side of the shack by the Goddess Statue for a mini medal.
Fight [[Green Dragon]]s in the castle ruins for 656 Exp each, but heal after their party-wide Flame Breath.
Climb the ladder by the northeast bridge.
Smash the pots there for a mini medal.
Beat the [[Cannibox]] in the left chest of the northwest building.
Take the [[Dragon Scale]] from the right chest.
Equip the [[Dragon Scale]] on the Luminary or Erik.
Climb into the well by the friendly Slime to enter the castle.
Duck under the fallen pillar south of the gravestone for [[Dress Like a Drasilian]].
Take the [[Devil's Tail]] from the north building.
Build [[Jade]] in Spears toward [[Multithrust]] and [[Rab]] in Heavy Wands once they join.

get: Mini medal - chest at the shack southwest of the castle ruins
Mini medal - pots up the ladder in the northeast castle ruins
[[Dragon Scale]] - right-hand chest in the northwest ruined building
[[Dress Like a Drasilian]] - under the fallen pillar south of the gravestone
[[Drasilian Sovereign]] - northwestern island chest

chapters.title: To Puerto Valor
chapters.goal: Clear The Costa Valor, cash in medals, quests and casino prizes in Puerto Valor, then open the sluice to the outer sea.

steps.t: Sail northwest from the Gondolia dock to the Costa Valor dock.
Grab the [[Tortoise Shell]] chest on the hidden south beach and the [[Coral Hairpin]] chest on the offshore islet.
Climb into the well by the camp for a [[Pitch Pearl]] chest.
In Puerto Valor, climb the spiral stairs beside the Casino for a 1300G chest.
Accept [[Anything for Love]] in town.
Accept [[Shiver me Timbers!]] in town.
Accept [[A Rush of Blood]] in town.
Trade your first 20 mini medals in the Hotel for a [[Shield-Bearer]], [[Hermes' Hat]] and [[Rune Staff]].
Deliver the letter to Valentino in the beach restaurant.
Report in Gondolia for a mini medal.
Take [[Your Crafting Career Starts Here]] from the house west of the restaurant.
Get [[All Things Nice]] from the man in red.
Fight [[Robbin' 'Ood]] on Insula Australis.
Drop his [[Merry Man]] crew with [[Zap]] and [[Sizzle]].
Cure sealed spells.
Defeat a [[Coralossus]] on the Costa Valor beach for the Floral Coral.
Turn in both quests.
Buy [[Down the Rabbithole]] with casino tokens.
Play poker for double or nothing.
Step out of the casino and back in to autosave your winnings.
Forge the [[Bunny Suit]].
Dress Jade in the [[Bunny Suit]], the [[Bunny Ears]] and [[Fishnet Stockings]] to finish the old man's quest.
Talk to Servantes in Don Rodrigo's mansion so he opens the sluice.
Sail to the Valor-Sauvage Channel west of town.
Follow the stream into the fog.

get: Mini medal - Hotel bedroom pot
Mini medal - reward for An Even Lovelier Letter
[[Your Crafting Career Starts Here]] - bookshelf in the house west of the restaurant
[[All Things Nice]] - man in red at the entrance
[[Down the Rabbithole]] - casino prize
[[Coral Hairpin]] - Costa Valor northeast beach chest

chapters.title: The Green Orb
chapters.goal: Find Kai for the mermaid Michelle, beat Tentacular, and receive the Green Orb from Queen Marina in Nautica.

level.t: Be around level 24 or higher before sailing to Lonalulu.

steps.t: Open the chest behind the western ship on The Strand for a mini medal.
Talk to Jade and Michelle.
Climb the steps left of the arch on Insula Incognita for [[Crafting Comforting Clothing]].
Beware the hard-hitting [[Cyclops]] there.
Smash the pots behind the cabin on Insula Occidentalis for a mini medal.
Grab the [[Slime Crown]] chest and the ruins mini medal on Insula Orientalis.
Hunt [[Liquid Metal Slime]]s that appear with [[King Slime]]s.
In Lonalulu, read the Armor shop shelf for [[My First Pearly Pieces]].
Open the chest behind the Weapons counter.
Search behind the beach stairs for 3000G and the barrels south of the Tavern for a mini medal.
Talk to the Canon Lady for a cannon.
Sail to the fleet while saving MP.
Fight [[Tentacular]] (around 1345 HP), focusing the main body.
Hit whichever tentacle shields the main body.
Use [[Hustle Dance]] after its multi-hit attacks.
Have Veronica cast [[Kasap]].
Have Veronica cast [[Frizzle]] with [[Oomph]] next.
Use Serena's [[Kabuff]] to soften party-wide hits.
Get the veil from Kainui.
Open the mini medal chest by Kainui's house on Saikiki Beach.
Give Michelle the veil at The Strand; telling the truth or lying both lead to [[Lorelei's Harp]].
Sail into the vortex southwest of the Zwaardsrust dock.
Play the harp there to reach Nautica.
Open the chest behind the church for a mini medal.
Speak to Queen Marina for the Green Orb.
Finish [[Up Where They Walk]] via the old man in Gondolia's northwest tower and [[My Secret Saint]] with the figure on Insula Orientalis.

get: Mini medal - The Strand, behind the western ship
Mini medal - Lonalulu, barrel south of the Tavern
[[Crafting Comforting Clothing]] - Insula Incognita, chest on top of the arch
[[My First Pearly Pieces]] - Lonalulu Armor shop bookshelf
[[Building a Blade of Blistering Brutality]] - Lonalulu Weapons shop chest
[[Lucida Shard]] - Insula Algarum, hidden northeast chest

chapters.title: The Silver Orb
chapters.goal: Explore The Champs Sauvage and the Academie, then climb The Eerie Eyrie and beat the Elysium Bird for the Silver Orb.

steps.t: Sail north from The Strand.
Head inland to the east.
Play the harp at the vortex.
Open the chest in the corner west of the south camp for a mini medal.
Mine the ore point east of the bridge for [[Platinum Ore]].
Forge Drasilian pieces for the Luminary at the camp.
Climb the rope east of the south bridge for a [[Vanguard]].
Take the center stairs to an [[Enchanted Stone]].
At the Academie, accept [[Making Things Right]].
Forge the [[Queen's Whip]] at +1 or higher for mini medals.
Buy pearls from the woman in the first room at 100G each to rework gear.
Search the Bibliotheque shelves for [[Next-Level Neckwear]] and [[Fine and Dandy Designs]].
Accept [[A Memorial Mystery]].
Dig up the gold spot in the flowers southwest of the door at night.
Accept [[The Agony and the Ecstasy]] upstairs.
Hand your medals to the Headmaster for [[Kit Fit for a King]].
In The Eerie Eyrie, ride a [[Rotten Eggsoskeleton]] to the ledge chests.
Take the school paper from behind the cave sign.
Ride a [[Demonrider]] up the claw-print wall.
Go south for [[Electrifying Equipment]].
Take [[Build Better Birds' Feet]] behind the waterfall and the chest with 4 [[Magic Water]].
Heal up.
Fight the [[Elysium bird]] (over 800 HP) and two [[Hades condor]]s.
Raise [[Magic Barrier]] and Hymn of Fire.
If [[Veronica]] is level 29 or higher, have her cast [[Boom]] on the whole enemy group.
Kill the condors first.
Keep damage steady through the bird's heals.
Open the final chest for the Silver Orb.
Report back at the Academie.

get: Mini medal - Champs Sauvage, west of the south camp
Mini medal - Eerie Eyrie, central stream chest
[[Next-Level Neckwear]] - Academie Bibliotheque
[[Fine and Dandy Designs]] - Academie Bibliotheque
[[Electrifying Equipment]] - Eerie Eyrie, west of the camp by the back route
[[Build Better Birds' Feet]] - behind the northern waterfall

chapters.title: The Purple Orb
chapters.goal: Free Phnom Nonh from the cursed mural by beating Dora-in-Grey, take the Magic Key, and open the Zwaardsrust ruins door for the Purple Orb.

level.t: Be around level 29 entering The Other Side and level 30 for Dora-in-Grey.

steps.t: Open the chest behind the market stall for a [[Dragon Horn]].
Accept [[Light it Up]] south of the square.
Ask the weather cow when it will rain.
Rest until it rains.
Beat a [[Brollygagger]] for the cloth.
Buy Erik the [[Sword Breaker]].
Read [[Dragony Designs]] in the house south of the Weapons shop.
Smash the pots on the top floor of the house east of the Armor shop for a mini medal.
Follow the balcony of the house west of the church to a hidden chest with 10 pearls.
Open the chest behind the ruins for [[Knick-Knacks for Nifty Nickers]].
Talk to the woman with Bunny Ears upstairs at the Inn for a puff-puff and 5 Charm.
Heal.
Open the big chest on the east side path to fight the [[Colossal Cannibox]] (560 HP).
Keep HP above 150.
On the second visit, open the chests for a [[Platinum Platter]], an [[Enchanted Stone]] and a mini medal.
Level to 30 near the Goddess Statue.
Add Serena if she has [[Snap, Crackle, Poof]].
Fight [[Dora-in-Grey]] (1,200 HP): Serena shields herself and the Luminary from charm, and [[Hustle Dance]] follows each laser.
Deal damage with Jade's [[Multithrust]] after Veronica's [[Oomphle]], plus [[Sap]] and the Luminary's [[Unbridled Blade]].
Go down the eastern stairs in the Zwaardsrust ruins.
Unlock the door for [[Classy Clobber for Kingly Kids]], an [[Enchanted Stone]] and the Purple Orb.
Take the gold sparkly spot in the same room for the [[Choker]].

get: Mini medal - top-floor pot, house east of the Armor shop
Mini medal - Cursed Cloisters lower level chest
[[Dragony Designs]] - bookshelf south of the Weapons shop
[[Knick-Knacks for Nifty Nickers]] - chest behind the ruins
[[Papillon Pendant]] - from the Colossal Cannibox
[[Classy Clobber for Kingly Kids]] - Zwaardsrust ruins Magic Key room

chapters.title: The Magic Key
chapters.goal: Use the Magic Key on the red doors around Erdrea and finish the Emerald Coast and Insula Isles crossbow targets before Sniflheim.

steps.t: Open the northwest door on Insula Australis for a [[Slime Crown]].
Shoot the Emerald Coast targets.
Report at the campsite for [[Seed of Magic]]s.
Open the door southeast of your Cobblestone home for a [[Wristorative]], which heals 25 HP a turn at +3.
Open the Downtown Heliodor door for 5000G.
Open the door west of the Hotto Steppe ore point for a [[Banishing Blade]].
Open the Gallopolis door by the Tavern for 2000G, [[Making the Magic Happen]], a [[Seed of Skill]] and a mini medal.
Open the Gondolia door by the Item shop for [[Divine Designs]], a [[Seed of Magic]] and a mini medal.
Open the tower door southwest of the Dundrasil camp for a stack of mini medals.
Open the Puerto Valor door near the beach for a [[Falcon Knife Earring]], Erik's twin-strike dagger.
Open the Lonalulu hilltop door for [[Zombie Mail]], a mini medal and a [[Seed of Life]].
Open the Academie door in the northwest of the first floor for a [[Thunderball]], a mini medal and a [[Seed of Skill]].
Open the Phnom Nonh door for [[Secrets of the Silversmiths]] and a [[Sage's Elixir]].
Open the north door on Insula Occidentalis for a [[Falcon Blade]].
Sail through the vortex east of Insula Borealis to Insula Centralis for a mini medal, the last target and a [[Sainted Soma]].
Report on Insula Occidentalis.

get: Mini medal - Gallopolis, Gondolia and Lonalulu Magic Key rooms
Mini medal - Dundrasil tower Magic Key room
[[Making the Magic Happen]] - Gallopolis Magic Key room
[[Divine Designs]] - Gondolia Magic Key room
[[Secrets of the Silversmiths]] - Phnom Nonh Magic Key room
[[Wristorative]] - Cobblestone Magic Key room

chapters.title: The Blue Orb
chapters.goal: Thaw Sniflheim by beating Jormun in the Hekswood, learning the witch's secret in the Royal Library, and defeating Krystalinda for the Blue Orb.

level.t: Fight Krystalinda at around level 31 or higher.

steps.t: Grab the [[Magic Beast Hide]] from the pier barrels.
Rest at the camp behind the city.
Forge the [[Hocus Locus]] for Veronica and Rab, buying any missing [[Silkblossom]] from the camp merchant.
Unlock the Magic Key door at the back to enter the frozen city.
Talk to the Queen.
Open the cabin chest northwest of the city for a mini medal.
Ride a [[Face Invader]] in the Snaerfelt.
Ram the ice blocks by holding R2.
Cross the western archway for a mini medal chest.
Take [[Supercool Kit]] from behind the cabin by the Hekswood.
In the Hekswood, follow the western ice path south to [[Platinum Protection]].
Fight [[Jörmun]] (820 HP) solo.
Keep HP above 100.
Use [[Unbridled Blade]] after its jig drops its defence.
Hit switches in the Royal Library to move shelves.
Take both recipe books from the Level 3 shelves.
Kill the [[Mimic]] (around 720 HP) on Level 4 quickly with [[Sap]], [[Unbridled Blade]] and [[Multithrust]] before it uses [[Thwack]].
Fight [[Krystalinda]] (1800 HP).
Raise [[Magic Barrier]].
Cast [[Sap]] on her.
Cast [[Oomph]] on the Luminary and Jade.
Keep [[Hustle Dance]] going.
Take the [[Nobleman's Knife]] for Erik and the basement mini medal in the castle.
Get the Blue Orb.
Accept [[The Viking Hoard]].
Accept [[A Cold Crush]].
Read the Inn bookshelf for [[Platinum Power]].
Pick the gold Snaerose south of the Snaerfelt camp for [[That's Magic]].
Bring the Viking's gift from Insula Borealis.

get: Mini medal - cabin chest northwest of the city
Mini medal - Snaerfelt chest across the archway
Mini medal - Sniflheim Castle basement pot
[[Supercool Kit]] - behind the cabin near the Hekswood
[[Favourite Fashions of the Masters of Magic]] - Royal Library Level 3
[[An Anthology of Elemental Earrings]] - Royal Library Level 3

chapters.title: Onward to Yggdrasil
chapters.goal: Reach Arboria, clear the First Forest and its two quests, and open the path to Yggdrasil to close Act I.

level.t: Be level 32 or higher for the upper Arborian Highlands.

steps.t: Ride a [[Runny Eggsoskeleton]] up the Pit Cave to the chest with a mini medal.
Loot Arboria: the mini medal chest by the entrance stairs, the [[Supplicant]] upstairs in the twins' house and the Item shop [[Sainted Soma]].
Accept [[Fit as a Fiddle]] from the old man and [[Planting Seeds for the Future]] in the Grove of Repose.
Zoom to the Academie.
Trade medals for the [[Agility Gilet]] and [[Glombolero]].
Shoot the Manglegrove targets.
Report to the camp bowyer.
See Bo in Gallopolis for the [[Happy Hat]].
Open the chest north of the first fork in the Arborian Highlands for a mini medal.
Forge a [[Platinum Lance]] for Jade at the camp.
Rework any pieces you are equipping that are not at +3.
Open the cave chest in the First Forest for [[How to Outdo the Undead]].
Pick the gold sparkly spot under the large northern tree for the Red Kale.
Fight [[Sprite Bulb]]s near the top until a [[Wight Bulb]] appears and drops the seeds.
Zoom to Arboria.
Turn in both quests for a [[Healer]] and a [[Butterfly Baton]].
Use the well at the World Tree to return to the great altar.
Open the chest behind the altar for a mini medal.
Pick up the [[Yggdrasil Dew]].
Keep the [[Yggdrasil Dew]] for emergencies.
Against [[Jasper]] at the Heart of Yggdrasil, use only buffs and healing; the fight cannot be won.

get: Mini medal - Pit Cave chest
Mini medal - Arboria, chest south of the entrance stairs
Mini medal - Arborian Highlands, north chest
Mini medal - First Forest, behind the great altar
[[How to Outdo the Undead]] - First Forest cave chest
[[Happy Hat]] - Bo, for every crossbow target
